question: If 1 + 2tan²θ + 2sinθ sec²θ = (a)/(b). 0° (a+b)/(a-b) = ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Substitute θ = 30° in the given expression: 0° [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** 1 + 2tan²θ + 2sinθ sec²θ = a/b

**Formula Used:** sec²θ = 1 + tan²θ; cos²θ = 1 − sin²θ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86cccb436b654d61f998b5a807083769f0a31b7358407eeea5982b4bbdd27c22.png] 

⇒ a/b = 1 + 2(sin²θ ÷ cos²θ) + 2sinθ ÷ cos²θ

⇒ a/b = (cos²θ + 2sin²θ + 2sinθ) ÷ cos²θ

⇒ a/b = (1 − sin²θ + 2sin²θ + 2sinθ) ÷ (1 − sin²θ)

⇒ a/b = (1 + sin²θ + 2sinθ) ÷ (1 − sin²θ)

⇒ a/b = (1 + sinθ)² ÷ [(1 + sinθ)(1 − sinθ)]

⇒ a/b = (1 + sinθ) ÷ (1 − sinθ)

⇒ Applying Componendo & Dividendo rule: (a + b) ÷ (a − b) = [(1 + sinθ) + (1 − sinθ)] ÷ [(1 + sinθ) − (1 − sinθ)]

⇒ (a + b) ÷ (a − b) = 2 ÷ 2sinθ = 1/sinθ = cosecθ

**∴ The correct answer is cosecθ.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Componendo and Dividendo Rule

If x/y = p/q, then (x + y) ÷ (x − y) = (p + q) ÷ (p − q). This is a useful shortcut for solving ratio-based trigonometric equations.

Fundamental Identities

sin²θ + cos²θ = 1 | 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ | 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ.

Reciprocal Ratios

cosecθ = 1 ÷ sinθ | secθ = 1 ÷ cosθ | cotθ = 1 ÷ tanθ.</p
